Ben (sales): Nora seeing 429s during POC stress run. Can we triage?
Aisha (sales-eng): can you paste the exact curl and response headers if you have them?
Nora (Acme): here: ```bash
curl -i -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-acme" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-small-rl","input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit: 25;w=1;burst=50
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 9
{"error":{"message":"route capacity exceeded","code":429}}
```
Derek (SRE): looks like per-route cap 25r/s burst 50. Tenant tokens don't matter for this limiter.
Ben (sales): they have 12M tokens left per tenant UI. Demo at 20:00 UTC, need quick fix.
Jules (infra): internal check: `GET /admin/routes/r-acme-default` -> rate_limit {per_second:25, burst:50, mode:strict}
Aisha (sales-eng): typical presales pattern: tenant credits reserved but per-route not bumped. Short term option: raise per_second to 200, burst 500 for 2h. Long term: reservation workflow.
Derek (SRE): proposing change now. Patch command: `PATCH /admin/routes/r-acme-default` with {rate_limit:{per_second:200,burst:500,mode:"soft"}}
QuotaBot: route r-acme-default rate_limit change proposed by derek at 2024-07-17T18:10:45Z (25->200,50->500). Confirm yes/no.
Aisha (sales-eng): +1 approve.
Jules (infra): applied, response 200 OK.
Jules (infra): returned payload: route_id r-acme-default, rate_limit per_second 200 burst 500, updated_by derek
Nora (Acme): running 300 concurrent requests now. First 3 minutes: 0 429s, latency ~120ms median. Thanks team! :tada:
Derek (SRE): leaving soft bump until 20:15 UTC then auto-revert. Added note to route and ticket for presales automation.
Ben (sales): follow-up: please create reservation PR and notify finance of temporary bump. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
